expectations.text: The review uses the exact Beijing-day UTC window 2026-07-13T16:00:00Z to 2026-07-14T16:00:00Z.
expectations.evidence: The report states the exact Beijing and UTC window in its opening note.

expectations.text: Every progress item cites an in-window Thread message or a directly verified artifact.
expectations.evidence: The report says nmem lacks per-message timestamps and therefore relies on Thread creation time/message indexes for several items; that does not prove each cited message is in-window and it omits valid later messages from long Threads.

expectations.text: The output separates progress, unfinished work, Next Actions, Waiting For, and uncertain items without inventing empty sections.
expectations.evidence: It separates 今日推进 and 待跟进 and omits sections for which it makes no distinct claims.

claims.claim: nmem currently does not provide per-message timestamps.
claims.evidence: The Nowledge FS messages.jsonl records do contain timestamps; the skill collector successfully filtered 267 messages by them.

claims.claim: Cross-day continuation work cannot be reliably placed in the review window.
claims.evidence: Per-message timestamps make that placement possible, so the conservative omission loses real progress.

suggestions.reason: Add an assertion that long Threads with in-window continuation messages are included; this is the key discriminating behavior exposed by the run.

eval_feedback.overall: The eval found a real date-evidence failure, but should explicitly test long-Thread recall.
